description: Use this when the user asks to delete their data. Pass the profile_key and ref_ids to delete only those references, or leave ref_ids out to delete the whole profile: every reference, description and saved rule. Deletion is permanent. Returns how many references were deleted.

profile_key.description: The profile_key that add_refs returned. Keep it: it is the only way back to this profile and it is not recoverable.

ref_ids.description: Delete only these references and keep the profile. Leave out to delete the whole profile: every reference, description and saved rule.

name: delete_profile
title: Delete references or the profile
